# PS2

Every app in this list that runs on PS2. That is 3 apps with 0 for Plex and 3 for Jellyfin and 0 for Emby. Apps for more than one server count once per server. The legend is in [README.md](../README.md#legend) and every other platform is in [PLATFORMS.md](../PLATFORMS.md).

> **Want these apps to play straight from debrid or Usenet?** [rex](https://rex.debridmediamanager.com/) and [zurg](https://zurg.debridmediamanager.com/) are made by the team that keeps this list. [See what they do.](../README.md#from-the-maintainers)

## Video and general

- [jellyfin-ps2](https://github.com/jimmyBizMobile/jellyfin-ps2) - Homebrew PlayStation 2 client. `Jellyfin` · `PS2` · `MIT`
- [orbit-jellyfin](https://github.com/danielnuld/orbit-jellyfin) - PS2 homebrew player; the server transcodes to SD MPEG-2. `Jellyfin` · `PS2` · `GPL-3.0` `Free`

## Music

- [sammwyy/jellyfish](https://github.com/sammwyy/jellyfish) - PlayStation 2 homebrew music player. `Jellyfin` · `PS2` · `Open source`
